initiatives.name: DSA Nebraska
initiatives.description: The Lincoln chapter of Democratic Socialists of America, which also organizes at-large DSA members across Nebraska. It holds general meetings, brake light clinics, socials and book clubs.

initiatives.name: OutNebraska
initiatives.description: Statewide LGBTQ+ nonprofit based in Lincoln that tracks and lobbies on Nebraska legislation, shares voter resources, and runs the annual Prairie Pride Film Festival.

initiatives.name: Nebraska Appleseed
initiatives.description: Nebraska nonprofit law and policy advocacy group working on immigrant rights, food access, health care and housing, including litigation and ballot campaigns.

initiatives.name: Nebraska AIDS Project
initiatives.description: Nonprofit founded in 1984 offering free HIV testing, PrEP access, case management, a food pantry, and support groups, with offices in Omaha, Lincoln, Norfolk, Kearney, and Scottsbluff.

initiatives.name: Norfolk Area Pride
initiatives.description: Nonprofit serving LGBTQ+ people in Northeast Nebraska. Runs an annual Pride festival in Norfolk and offers community resources, education and gender-affirming clothing assistance.

initiatives.name: Nebraska Abortion Resources
initiatives.description: Nebraska's statewide abortion fund, covering procedure costs plus travel, lodging and childcare, and giving out free emergency contraception kits through its Speak E.C. program.
